problem.description: Python 3.11/3.12 lock could not resolve wetext with a cp310-only Windows wheel; compatibility audit also emitted invalid escape warnings

findings: The wheel publisher provides cp311 and cp312 Windows assets in the same fixed release.
A piped PowerShell CLI probe returned exit 1 because Select-Object stopped the producer; unpiped CLI help returned exit 0.
Two existing string literals produced escape warnings on newer Python runtimes.

resolution.root_cause: A single cp310 source rule covered the entire declared Python range; two literals used accidental escape syntax.
resolution.fix_applied: Select wheel URLs by Python ABI, pin mutable Git sources, and correct the literals.
resolution.verification: Locked installs and 540 tests each on Python 3.10/3.11/3.12; 42 focused tests on 3.10 and 3.12 after literal repair; lock and diff checks pass.
